_comment: The floor-grammar payload (companion to AIVIA_Design/Grammar_Floor.md, RATIFIED 2026-09-05): the EXACT deterministic floor text per F4 target. BINDING — F4 acceptance is byte-exact against these texts; the interim substring expectations are retired from service (kept as historical witnesses).

texts.usp_diabetic_visits.sql::#Recent:
This is a selection of patient encounters.
Drawn from encounter records.
- The visit date is on or after the start date parameter (default '2026-01-01' when none is supplied).
- The appointment status is 2 ('Completed').
texts.usp_diabetic_visits.sql::delivery:
This is a selection of diagnoses on an encounter.
Drawn from the recent selection defined earlier in this procedure, restricted to records also present in encounter dx records.
- The diagnosis code starts with 'E11'.
texts.usp_odd_join.sql::delivery:
This is a selection of patients.
Drawn from patient records, restricted to records also present in staging log records.
- No membership conditions are applied in this selection.
texts.vw_completed_visits.sql::delivery:
This is a selection of patient encounters.
Drawn from encounter records, restricted to records also present in patient records, restricted to records also present in org readmit records.
- The appointment status is one of the values 1 ('Scheduled'), 2 ('Completed').
